CheckTitle: Subscription has between 2 and 3 principals assigned the Owner role
Description: **Azure subscriptions** are evaluated for the number of principals holding the **Owner** role, whether assigned on the subscription or inherited from a management group. Users, groups, service principals and managed identities each count as one principal.
Risk:
**Too many owners** widen the set of identities that can change any resource, grant access or delete workloads, so one compromised account gains full control.

**A single owner** is a single point of failure: if that account is lost or disabled, nobody can manage access or respond to incidents.

Code.Other:
1. In the Azure portal, open Subscriptions and select the subscription
2. Go to Access control (IAM) > Role assignments and filter by Role = Owner
3. If more than 3 principals are listed, select the extra direct assignments (Scope: This resource) and remove them
4. Remove extra inherited assignments where they are granted: click the link next to (Inherited) in the Scope column and remove the assignment at that management group or root scope
5. If fewer than 2 are listed, click Add > Add role assignment and assign Owner to a second administrator or group

Recommendation.Text:
Keep **2 to 3 standing owners** per subscription so access can always be recovered without concentrating full control:
- Grant day-to-day work through narrower roles such as Contributor
- Use **PIM** for just-in-time Owner elevation
- Review Owner assignments and group membership regularly

Notes: Counts unique principals with an active Owner assignment on the subscription or inherited from a management group or the root scope, and reports the direct and inherited split. PIM-eligible assignments are not counted.
